extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to falsify the bounded good judgment by hunting for any path in which the 72-station retained subset serves as the exposure denominator of the reported claim: I traced every occurrence of SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS in workflow/analysis.py (found only at L0007 assignment and L0018 PASSED_LINE, an accounting line) and confirmed SELECTED_LINE at L0023 divides by SCHEDULED_STATIONS; I also re-derived the domain from inputs/data.csv (96 station rows, all scheduled=yes; 24 rows with screen_status=omitted; 18 rows with occurrence_flag=1) and recomputed 18/96 = 0.1875, matching the reported value. The attempt failed to produce a retained-subset denominator, so the in-scope mismatch is not entailed.

unresolved_material_questions: task.md L0001 refers to a 'revised' rate and a 'supplied base workflow', but no prior version is present in the repository; this does not affect whether the visible selected result uses a complete-domain denominator, but it means any comparison to a predecessor artifact cannot be checked.

The report treats the 24 never-observed stations as contributing zero occurrences; whether that missingness assumption is scientifically appropriate is outside the single in-scope issue class and cannot be adjudicated from the visible evidence.
